The original Zulip thread and PA minutes support the same linked-versus-merged distinction; related combined-branch audits for FHIR-17487 and FHIR-19687 do not require a different core rule.
reconciliation: Changed only source/administration-module.html to replace the stale undefined/seeking-feedback wording with the current Patient compartment rule and a link to compartmentdefinition-patient.html. The authoritative source/compartments.xml wording was left unchanged.
